description: QMA spin-glass / frustrated Ising: given integer couplings on edges and a presented +/-1 spin per site, return the exact Ising energy of that configuration, energy_num = the sum of J * s_i * s_j over the posted edges and energy_den = 1, detail energy=E. edges are i,j,J;... (the fixture 0,1,1;1,2,1;2,0,1 is the frustrated triangle), spins are +1,-1,... The verdict is graded against the one ground energy QMACourtLaw holds a seal for: -1, the frustrated triangle with spins 1,-1,1 (fixtureSpinEnergy). WIN means the posted configuration reaches that energy; MISS means an evaluated configuration that does not; a REFUSED_* verdict names an instance or configuration the law does not grade. The presented configuration is evaluated exactly; no annealing and no ground-state search. Same law as math_court domain qma_spinglass and verify_qaoa_energy. Floats refused (REFUSED_FLOAT); a field posted as a JSON value that is not a string is REFUSED_NOT_A_STRING.

spins.description: discrete spins +1,-1,... one per site, e.g. 1,-1,1
